spots.name: Lytle Ranch Preserve
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 292 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L208278.

spots.name: Comet Peak
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 2,843 m (9,328 ft).
